content.text:
The root cause is clear. Summary of the investigation:

**Why you got the error:** In this version of Prime Agent (0.9.5), `update --extension` (and `--extensions`) is no longer a valid argument — the feature was moved. The CLI explicitly rejects it and exits with code 1:

```
Error: Package updates moved to the package command.
Use "prime-agent package update [source]".
```

The interactive `/update` UI then just reports that exit code as `Update exited with code 1` (it wraps every nonzero exit that way).

**Verified fix:** The correct command works fine on your machine:

```
prime-agent package update
```

I ran it — it updated both user and project npm packages plus the `git:github.com/maximerivest/pi-modes` extension, finished with `Updated packages`, exit 0.

So:
- **Old (broken):** `prime-agent update --extension` → exit 1, "Package updates moved to the package command."
- **New (working):** `prime-agent package update` (or in the interactive UI, just run `/update` without flags to self-update Prime Agent itself).

If you want to update only one extension, you can pass a source, e.g. `prime-agent package update git:github.com/maximerivest/pi-modes`.
